note: HYK-153-engine-profile-1 (piece B, coder-task.md §2): single config point for role defaults (engine/model/effort) and the per-engine attributes that production code used to branch on by literal engine name. `config/` is not an installer-copied top-level folder (templates/harness-init/install.mjs has no top-level `config/` copy list, grep-verified before this round) so this file lives beside its reader engine-profile.mjs under scripts/check/ instead -- not scripts/relay/, where it was first written: eslint.config.mjs's no-restricted-imports rule makes scripts/relay/* a one-way sink (nothing outside scripts/relay/ may import from it), so a module consumed by both scripts/check/* and scripts/relay/* files has to live on the check side.
